headlines.summary:

Pan Gongsheng, governor of the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), pledged in a work report presented to the standing committee of the National People’s Congress on Tuesday that more actions would be taken to ease financial risks in key areas, including the capital market and the property sector.

headlines.title: 国家发展改革委召开“六张网”重大项目建设总体调度会议
headlines.summary: 2026年11月5日，国家发展改革委党组成员、副主任岳修虎同志主持召开会议，总体调度“六张网”各领域规划建设进展情况，研究部署下一阶段重点工作。会议听取“六张网”各牵头部门和资金、土地等要素保障部门工作情况介绍，研究会商当前面临的主要问题。会议强调，各有关部门要进一步做好规划方案衔接，抓紧出台配套政策，加快项目库建设和信息共享，加强重大项目调度和资金、土地等要素保障，支持“六网协同”新场景培育打造，研究制定明年工作计划，确保“六张网”建设高效有序推进。工业和信息化部、财政部、自然资源部、生态环境部、住房城乡建设部、交通运输部、水利部、中国人民银行、国务院

headlines.title_en: National Development and Reform Commission holds general coordination meeting on major 'Six Networks' project construction
headlines.summary_en: On November 5, 2026, Yue Xiuhu, Member of the Party Leadership Group and Vice Chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission, chaired a meeting to coordinate overall progress in the planning and construction of the "six networks" across various sectors and to study and deploy key tasks for the next stage. The meeting heard introductions from the lead departments for each of the "six networks" and from departments responsible for funding, land and other element support, and discussed and consulted on the main problems currently faced. The meeting emphasized that relevant departments should further align planning schemes, promptly introduce supporting policies, accelerate project library development and information sharing, strengthen scheduling of major projects and support for funding, land and other elements, support the cultivation and creation of new scenarios for "six-network coordination," and study and formulate work plans for next year to ensure the efficient and orderly advancement of "six networks" construction. headlines.title: 证监会同意广期所氢氧化锂期货和期权注册

Listing lithium hydroxide futures and options is a concrete measure for the futures market to continue building and improving its product system and enhance financial support for green development. headlines.title: 锐方基金5亿元自购旗下基金产品，刷新私募单笔纪录
headlines.summary: 锐方（上海）私募基金管理有限公司发布自购公告称，基于对中国资本市场长期稳健发展的看好，以及对团队主动管理能力的信心，锐方基金及核心成员将于本公告发布之日起两周内，以自有资金5亿元申购公司旗下产品。 这笔5亿元的自购，不仅远超年内单家私募自购的普遍水平，也有望刷新近年私募行业单笔自购的规模纪录。（中国基金报）

headlines.title_en: Ruifang Fund buys 500 million yuan of its own fund products, setting new single private fund record
headlines.summary_en: Ruifang (Shanghai) Private Fund Management Co., Ltd. issued a self-purchase announcement stating that based on optimism about the long-term steady development of China's capital market and confidence in the team's active management capability, Ruifang Fund and its core members will use 500 million yuan of their own funds to subscribe to the company's products within two weeks from the date of this announcement. This 500 million yuan self-purchase not only far exceeds the general level of self-purchases by a single private fund during the year, but is also expected to set a record for the scale of a single self-purchase in the private fund industry in recent years. (China Fund News)

headlines.title: 美国先减关税、中国再履行农产品采购承诺？外交部：建议询问主管部门
headlines.summary: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会。路透社记者提问，中国商务部发言人昨日表示，中国一贯对扩大自美国采购农产品持开放态度，但前提是双方落实此前商定的300亿美元互惠降税协议。这是否意味着除非关税削减，否则中方不会开始履行170亿美元的农产品采购承诺？ “这个问题建议向中方主管部门进一步询问。”郭嘉昆表示，维护中美经贸关系稳定发展，符合两国和两国人民利益，也有利于全球经济发展。双方要相向而行，坚持互利共赢导向，推动中美经贸关系持续稳定向好发展。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: US to cut tariffs first, China to fulfill agricultural purchase commitments afterward? Foreign Ministry: suggest asking competent authorities
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun hosted a regular press conference. A Reuters reporter asked: A spokesperson for China's Ministry of Commerce said yesterday that China has always been open to expanding purchases of agricultural products from the United States, but the premise is that both sides implement the previously agreed $30 billion reciprocal tariff reduction agreement. Does this mean that unless tariffs are cut, China will not begin to fulfill its $17 billion agricultural product purchase commitment? "I suggest you ask the competent Chinese authorities for further information on this question," Guo Jiakun said. Maintaining the stable development of China-US economic and trade relations is in the interests of both countries and both peoples and is also conducive to global economic development. Both sides should move toward each other, adhere to the orientation of mutual benefit and win-win results, and promote the sustained, stable and sound development of China-US economic and trade relations. (The Paper)

headlines.title: 国泰海通完成第三批互换便利业务首批股票买入
headlines.summary: 国泰海通第三批“证券、基金、保险公司互换便利（SFISF）”业务完成前期准备工作，已开展回购融资交易，并完成首批股票买入操作。国泰海通表示，将继续利用互换便利工具，增持A股股票及股票ETF。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: Guotai Haitong completes first stock purchases under third batch of swap facility business
headlines.summary_en: Guotai Haitong completed the preliminary preparations for the third batch of Securities, Funds and Insurance Companies Swap Facility (SFISF) business, has conducted repo financing transactions, and completed the first batch of stock purchase operations. Guotai Haitong stated that it will continue to use the swap facility tool to increase holdings of A-share stocks and stock ETFs. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 税收征收管理法修订草案向社会公开征求意见
headlines.summary: 该修订草案共六章100条，较现行税收征管法新增13条、删除7条、修改75条，章节设置保持现行税收征管法基本架构。本次修订聚焦贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，充分适应新经济、新业态发展需要，更好落实税收法定原则，对接个人所得税等新税制改革，巩固和拓展税收征管改革成果，既突出保障国家税收安全，又注重维护法治公平经济税收秩序，并将纳税人合法权益保护贯穿制度设计全链条，进一步为广大经营主体特别是合规经营纳税人营造公平、透明、可预期的发展环境。

headlines.title_en: Draft revision of Tax Collection and Administration Law open for public comment
headlines.summary_en: The draft amendment has six chapters and 100 articles. Compared with the current Tax Collection and Administration Law, it adds 13 articles, deletes 7 articles and modifies 75 articles, while maintaining the basic chapter structure of the current Tax Collection and Administration Law. This amendment focuses on implementing the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, fully adapting to the development needs of the new economy and new business forms, better implementing the principle of statutory taxation, aligning with new tax system reforms such as individual income tax, and consolidating and expanding the achievements of tax collection and administration reform. It both highlights safeguarding national tax security and emphasizes maintaining a law-based, fair economic and tax order, and runs the protection of taxpayers' lawful rights and interests through the entire chain of institutional design, further creating a fair, transparent and predictable development environment for the broad market entities, especially law-abiding taxpayers.

headlines.title_en: Southbound funds record net purchases of RMB 2.415 billion today
headlines.summary_en: Southbound funds recorded a net purchase of 2.415 billion yuan today. On the Stock Connect (Shanghai) side, Alibaba-W and Tencent Holdings received net purchases of HK$591 million and HK$522 million respectively; Xiaomi Group-W had the largest net sell amount at HK$798 million. On the Stock Connect (Shenzhen) side, Meituan-W and Tencent Holdings received net purchases of HK$271 million and HK$238 million respectively; SMIC had the largest net sell amount at HK$469 million.

headlines.title: “购在中国·2026精品消费月”启动

headlines.title_en: "Buy in China · 2026 Premium Consumption Month" launched
headlines.summary_en: On November 6, the launch ceremony of the "Shopping in China · 2026 Quality Consumption Month" was held in Shanghai. Vice Minister of Commerce Yan Dong attended and delivered remarks. Shanghai Vice Mayor Wang Huajie, Beijing Vice Mayor Tang Wenhong, Chongqing Vice Mayor Huang Maojun, and Guangzhou Executive Vice Mayor Bian Liming attended and introduced their cities' key activities and measures. The Ministry of Commerce earnestly implements the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on expanding domestic demand and boosting consumption, closely combines improving people's livelihoods with promoting consumption, and organizes the "Shopping in China · 2026 Quality Consumption Month" campaign. Focusing on quality themes and highlighting international features, it leverages the demonstration and leading role of international consumption center cities to create the flagship annual event of "Shopping in China" and continuously unlock consumption potential.

headlines.title: 创新高！港交所前三季度赚超154亿港元，陈翊庭发声

headlines.title_en: Record high! HKEX earns over HK$15.4 billion in first three quarters, Bonnie Chan speaks
headlines.summary_en: HKEX officially released its results announcement for the first three quarters ended September 30. The financial report shows that HKEX's revenue and profit attributable to shareholders for the first nine months both hit record highs for the same period, but third-quarter profit alone edged down year on year; IPO fundraising was booming and Northbound trading surged, while Southbound trading by mainland funds in Hong Kong stocks contracted significantly.

headlines.title: 商务部：与欧盟对华贸易救济立案数量相比，中方在贸易救济领域一贯审慎克制
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人就涉及欧盟的进口对位芳纶长丝和乙叉降冰片烯两起反倾销调查答记者问。 有记者问：我们关注到商务部今日对涉及欧盟的进口对位芳纶长丝和乙叉降冰片烯发起两起反倾销调查，能否介绍相关情况？ 答：相关调查均应国内产业申请发起。申请人提供的初步证据显示，2023年至2026年上半年，自欧进口对位芳纶长丝产品的数量处于高位，价格累计跌幅超50%。自欧盟等地区进口的乙叉降冰片烯数量2023年至2025年累计增长27.35%，2026年上半年同比增长56%，且价格整体呈下降趋势。申请人主张，相关倾销进口产品对中国国内产业生产经营造成了损害。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Compared with the number of EU trade remedy cases against China, China has consistently been prudent and restrained in the trade remedy field
headlines.summary_en: A spokesperson for the Ministry of Commerce answered questions on two anti-dumping investigations involving imports from the EU of para-aramid filament and ethylidene norbornene. A reporter asked: We noted that the Ministry of Commerce today initiated two anti-dumping investigations into imports from the EU of para-aramid filament and ethylidene norbornene. Could you brief us on the relevant situation? Answer: Both investigations were initiated upon applications from the domestic industry. Preliminary evidence provided by the applicants shows that from 2023 to the first half of 2026, the volume of imported para-aramid filament products from the EU remained at a high level, with prices falling by more than 50% cumulatively. Imports of ethylidene norbornene from the EU and other regions grew by 27.35% cumulatively from 2023 to 2025 and by 56% year on year in the first half of 2026, with prices generally trending downward. The applicants claim that the dumped imported products have caused harm to the production and operations of China's domestic industry.

headlines.title: 洛阳钼业：拟以10亿元-20亿元回购公司股份
headlines.summary: 洛阳钼业公告，拟以集中竞价交易方式回购A股股份，回购资金总额为人民币10亿元（含）-20亿元（含），回购价格不超过22.78元/股，回购股份用途为维护公司价值及股东权益所必需。按回购金额上限测算，预计回购股份数量为8779.63万股，占公司总股本的0.41%；按回购金额下限测算，预计回购股份数量为4389.82万股，占公司总股本的0.21%。回购期限为自董事会审议通过本次回购方案之日起3个月内，资金来源为自有资金或自筹资金。

headlines.title_en: CMOC Group: Plans to repurchase RMB 1 billion-2 billion of company shares
headlines.summary_en: CMOC announced that it plans to repurchase A-share shares through centralized bidding, with a total repurchase amount of RMB 1 billion (inclusive) to RMB 2 billion (inclusive), and a repurchase price of no more than 22.78 yuan per share. The repurchased shares are for the purpose necessary to safeguard the company's value and shareholders' rights and interests. Based on the upper limit of the repurchase amount, the expected number of repurchased shares is 87.7963 million shares, accounting for 0.41% of the company's total share capital; based on the lower limit of the repurchase amount, the expected number of repurchased shares is 43.8982 million shares, accounting for 0.21% of the company's total share capital. The repurchase period is within 3 months from the date the board of directors deliberates and approves the repurchase plan, and the source of funds is own funds or self-raised funds.
